meta.title: A single-stage RFQ publishes
warnings: added compose_stages(rfq) — the screen defaults to an Auction stage, so this test would have run against the wrong stage
moved open_create to the front — the steps before it had no create screen to act on
dropped the stage steps — the single-stage screen has no stage tabs; its type is set in the drawer

steps.note: Open the single-stage event create screen as requested by the test case setup.
Configure the single-stage event as an RFQ with lot-based awarding.
Give the event a unique generated title.
Pick the stage's pricing template so line items can be added.
Add the first line item to the sheet.
Fill the pricing sheet for the line item.
Set and commit the event schedule.
Add at least one participant to the event.
Assert the browser reached a real project page with an id (/project/:id/details).
Assert that no error toast or message appeared during or after publishing.
